items.jobDescription:
**_IS THIS YOU?_**

**Is owning a big system full of pipelines, bots and AI agents the next step in your growth trajectory?**

**Have you ever traced a wrong number back to its source, then rebuilt the pipeline so it could never happen again?**

**When someone quotes a number that feels too big or too small, are you already in the raw data checking it?**

 

Then you know the feeling. You’ve always been the one who builds systems that hold up, and that’s exactly why false data rarely fools you. At Myner, the whole business runs on your work (no pressure): the data that drives growth for brands has to be clean and trustworthy, and you’re the one who makes sure it is.

 

**_ABOUT MYNER_**

### Stop waiting. Start growing.

Myner is building the world’s first global consumer omni-panel: a unified, always-on stream of what people buy, consume, watch and think. Myner transforms that data into the fuel that powers our Agentic Flywheels for consumer brands — always-on, continuous loops that both create and validate new product concepts, marketing campaign ideas and more.

 

**_THE DATA FACTORY_**

The Myner app mines the gold from receipts and surveys, and our scrapers haul in mountains of golden data too. The Data Factory refines it all into gold bars. It cleans, processes, matches and weights raw data, so the rest of the company and our partners can build on it with confidence. You own the refinery, and you keep it running, accurate and trustworthy as we grow.

 

**_THE ROLE_**

### Own the data refinery.

You own the refinement of Myner's raw data into trusted data products, and lead part of the engineering team that builds it, working closely with our CTO.

 

**_WHAT YOU WILL OWN_**

- Receipt extraction: turn receipt images and messy text into structured data, and measure and benchmark how accurate it really is.
- Product matching: match every possible item on a receipt to a real product, brand and category, and enrich it with external data, including data we collect by scraping.
- Weighting and projection: turn our panel data into numbers that represent the market through weighting, balancing and projection. This is one of the most important parts of the job.
- Fraud and quality: develop methods that detect fraud and low-quality data, and feed them back to the Myner app and customer support, so they can act on it, ideally automatically.
- AI-first pipelines: build transformations that are fast to change and easy to verify, with AI doing most of the heavy lifting.
- Moving data where it's needed: get data out of our app database and into the systems that refine and analyze it.
- Shape the stack: nothing is set in stone. You'll choose the technology together with the CTO and the team, and your voice will carry a lot of weight.
 

**_WHAT YOU BRING_**

- Builder: you have built, designed and maintained real production data systems yourself, as an early-stage CTO, tech lead or architect, and you have something to show us.
- Leader: you have led engineers, and you enjoy shaping both the architecture and the team that builds it.
- AI-first: most of the code you shipped in the last three-six months was written with AI, and you have built AI into production systems, not just prototypes.
- Data-first: you think in data quality, accuracy and evidence, and you don't trust a number until you know where it came from.
- Good judgment and taste: you make sound decisions, care how things look and feel, and are highly regarded by others for these talents.
- Cross-functional mindset: you work across teams naturally and never build walls around your own area.
- English: near-native is the level we're looking for, where you can express yourself clearly without difficulty.
- Self-managed: you plan your own time, make commitments and meet your own deadlines.
 

**_OUR STACK_**

- Source data: Supabase (Postgres), with change data capture into the analytics layer, for example PeerDB, Estuary, Airbyte or AWS DMS
- Receipt extraction: multimodal LLMs such as Claude or Gemini with structured output, AWS Textract as OCR fallback, and evaluation sets for accuracy benchmarking
- Product matching: embeddings and vector search such as pgvector, LLM-assisted matching, and scraping for external product data
- Transformations: SQL-based and AI-first, for example dbt or SQLMesh, with DuckDB for fast local iteration
- Weighting and projection: Python with Polars, and survey weighting methods such as raking
- Fraud detection: rules and models on panel data, wired back into the Myner app and customer support tooling
- Infrastructure: AWS, managed with Terraform
 

**_NOT A FIT_**

- Big data for its own sake: you prefer large-scale infrastructure to getting the data right. Our challenge is accuracy, not yet volume.
- No hands-on building: you've designed systems but haven't built and maintained them yourself.
- No AI experience: you haven't built software or data pipelines with AI yet. Working with AI is basic knowledge in this company.
- Department walls: you prefer owning your own area over working across teams. Here, the app, the data, support and engineering all connect.
- Pace: you prefer the rhythm of a large enterprise. We are a startup that tries things quickly and iterates a lot.
- Change: you get frustrated when plans change. We learn as we go, so some work stays and some goes straight into the bin.
 

**_TEAMWORK_**

- Remote, together: we work remotely, meet weekly or on demand, and meet in person once a month.
- Small team, big leverage: a 3–5 person engineering team with loads of AI harnesses that keep evolving.
- Delivery over hours: we care about what you ship, not when you work on it.
- Our primary working hours follow Central European Time.
 

**_HOW WE HIRE_**

### 4 steps. 3 hours. 2 weeks.

Our process is crisp and concise, built to give you a clear answer fast.

1. **Informational Interview** 30 MIN  
A direct conversation about the role, the team and what you're looking for. Bring your questions.
2. **Online Assessment** 30 MIN  
A brief skill and personality assessment that helps us evaluate your fit and guides our next interview.
3. **Team Interview** 90 MIN  
Work through real problems with the people you will build alongside.
4. **Founder Finale** 30 MIN  
Meet the founder & CEO. Talk ambition, ownership, culture and Myner's future.

Great candidates complete the entire process within 2 weeks of submitting their resume.

 

**_READY TO FLY?_**

### Apply now.

items.jobDescription:
**_IS THIS YOU?_**

**Have you ever had an idea so exciting that you spent the weekend building it?**

**Is your AI setup today different from the one you had three months ago?**

**Does it bother you more when a user gets stuck than when a test fails?**

Then you know the feeling. Your tools keep getting better, your ideas keep getting bigger, and you want to see them in people’s hands. At Myner, you don’t wait for the next quarter - you ship it next week.

 

**_ABOUT MYNER_**

### Endless room to build.

Myner is building the world’s first global consumer omni-panel: a unified, always-on stream of what people buy, consume, watch and think. Under that one sentence sits a lot of engineering:

- **We mine**. The Myner app turns receipts and surveys into data, and scrapers pull in various external sources.
- **We refine**. Pipelines, data lakes and quality checks turn messy raw signal into data brands bet their budgets on.
- **We craft**. Our experimentation engine turns ideas into working products in days, and we hack on them side by side with big-brand executives.
- **We improve the workshop**. The AI-native harness and infrastructure we all build with, rebuilt as fast as the models move.

Early on, you’ll touch all of it. Later, you go deep wherever it pulls you, and when that stops being fun, there’s always another seam to work.

 

**_THE ROLE_**

### Build it with AI. Ship it. Own it.

You join a small, senior team of product and engineering builders who use AI as the default, not the demo. You own features end to end — from the intent to production — wherever they live: the Myner app, the data pipelines or the agents brands work with.

 

**_WHAT YOU WILL OWN_**

- Ship end-to-end features — UI, APIs, data pipelines and the agents that connect them.
- Build and harden the agentic workflows that turn panel data into Marketing Flywheels clients act on.
- Turn ambiguous client problems into working prototypes in days, then into production systems.
- Set the bar for how the team builds with AI — tooling, evals, review practices and speed.
 

**_WHAT YOU BRING_**

- 4+ years of shipping production software, with real ownership of what you built.
- Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents and LLM APIs — and the shipped work to show for it.
- You’ve shipped production code in more than one language, and you pick up a new one easily.
- Product judgment and an eye for UX. You care how it feels to use, not just whether the code is clean.
- Clear written and spoken English. You blend in, make decisions and document with ease using English.
 

**_BONUS POINTS_**

- Evals, RAG or multi-agent systems running in production.
- A background in data platforms, analytics or consumer research.
- Founding or early-stage startup experience.
 

**_NOT A FIT_**

- Prefer deep tech and research over building with users.
- Coding manually rather than taking an AI-first approach
- Lack experience building systems that scale and stay secure.
- Value the steady rhythm of a large team over dynamic iteration
- Get frustrated when plans change and some work ends up unused.
 

**_TEAMWORK_**

- Team is remote-first with weekly + as-needed meetings with optional monthly meet-ups in Budapest.
- Team is small by design to create maximum leverage with loads of AI harnesses that we're always improving.
- Focus is on delivery over hours. We care about what you ship, not when you work.
 

**_HOW WE HIRE_**

### 4 steps. 3 hours. 2 weeks.

Our process is crisp and concise, built to give you a clear answer fast.

1. **Informational Interview** 30 MIN  
A direct conversation about the role, the team and what you're looking for. Bring your questions.
2. **Online Assessment** 30 MIN  
A brief skill and personality assessment that helps us evaluate your fit and guides our next interview.
3. **Team Interview** 90 MIN  
Work through real problems with the people you will build alongside.
4. **Founder Finale** 30 MIN  
Meet the founder & CEO. Talk ambition, ownership, culture and Myner's future.

Great candidates complete the entire process within 2 weeks of submitting their resume.

 

**_READY TO FLY?_**

### Apply now.

items.companyHighConcept: Trace your data to protect it like never before
items.jobDescription:
## About the role

Joining Cyberhaven offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of revolutionizing data protection through cutting-edge AI technology. Cyberhaven is dedicated to overcoming the challenges faced by traditional data security products, ensuring robust protection of critical data against insider threats in a rapidly evolving work environment. With a unique approach to data lineage, tracing data from its origin for better classification and protection, Cyberhaven combines the functionality of traditional data protection security tools into a single, more effective solution. This role not only allows you to contribute to the advancement of cloud and data security but also places you within a team of security and product professionals passionate about transforming the way data is protected.

We’re looking for an experienced endpoint developer to help drive and evolve our product. Our technology is new and rapidly evolving, and you’ll have a chance to be an early contributor with a substantial impact on the product architecture.

## What you'll do

- Design and implement components of our state-of-the-art system sensor that traces all data movement across all applications and files on macOS endpoints
- Solve challenging performance optimization problems: we’re building software that monitors hundreds of thousands of events with minimal impact on performance of the endpoint applications
- Design and build highly reliable code that never impacts the end-user experience
- Build secure-by-design hardened software that must withstand real-world attacks, while processing untrusted data and communicating with a backend over the internet

## Who you are

- Strong track record in working with Swift on macOS.
- Experience of building system extensions using Endpoint security framework and Network extensions
- Prior work on at least one large native application deployed to tens of thousands of end-users
- Experience debugging, profiling, and optimizing the performance of low-level system software using Instruments
- Experience building endpoint security products, such as DLP or EDR applications.
- Proficient in designing and implementing application architecture
- Experience with agile development and SCRUM
- Proven ability to collaborate with a distributed cross-functional team
- Possess verbal and written communication skills in English
- Availability to frequently communicate with a distributed engineering team in Central European and US Eastern time zones
- Located in the following locations: Romania, India, Poland

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

**AI Tools Disclosure:** As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*
